name: ccstatus-band
description: A table of live and per-turn token throughput, tokens and prompt-cache hit rate in the band above the Claude Code prompt

col_rate.description: Show the tok/s column. Decode rate: output tokens over the time spent generating them.
col_rate.title: tok/s column

col_ttft.description: Show the ttft column. Wait before the prompt's first generated chunk: prefill plus gateway queueing.
col_ttft.title: ttft column

col_out.description: Show the out column. Tokens the model generated.
col_out.title: out column

col_in.description: Show the in column. Prompt tokens not served from the cache.
col_in.title: in column

col_hit.description: Show the hit column. Share of the prompt served from the cache.
col_hit.title: hit column

col_turn.description: Show the turn column. Which prompt of the session this was, counting from 1.
col_turn.title: turn column

col_calls.description: Show the calls column. Model calls the prompt made that returned usage.
col_calls.title: calls column

col_total.description: Show the total column. Everything carried: uncached input + cache read + cache write + output.
col_total.title: total column
